data.narrative:
Sunflower Labs is a Series B drone and autonomous systems company that has raised $41.7M to date. The valuation universe comprises eight private peers in the Drones & Autonomous sector, including Elroy Air, Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, and Archer Aviation. No public comparables exist in this narrowly defined segment.

A stage-progression methodology was applied given the early-stage, pre-revenue nature of the target. Using total capital raised ($42M) as a proxy for Series B valuation, a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage transitions yields $79M. A peer-median approach was not applicable: while five same-sector peers exist, only one operates at the same stage, and insufficient adjacent-stage or similarly-valued comparables remain to support a robust triangulation (threshold: ≥3 datapoints). Applying an all-sector median would introduce undue noise given the heterogeneity of drone and autonomous subsegments.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $67M to $91M, with a central estimate of $79M. This range carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single methodology and the absence of near-peer stage and valuation alignment. Key sensitivities include the company's capital efficiency relative to stated peers, time-to-revenue trajectory, and the willingness of institutional investors to apply premium or discount multiples to stage-progression benchmarks in the current funding environment.
